title: Caafimaadka iyo jidhka
description: Ten short, simple stories about health and the body in Somali towns, the countryside and abroad: a father's heart, a baby on a cold night, a hurt leg after football, a goat herder in the summer heat, a girl's hair, a lesson on counting heartbeats, a fast motorcycle, a health centre in Baydhabo, an evening walk in Oslo and a busy nurse's lunch.

lessons.title: Wadnaha Jimcaale
lessons.summary: Jimcaale in Hargeysa loves rice with a lot of oil; one day his heart hurts, the doctor listens to his heart and tells him to eat less and walk, his son Mahdi buys the expensive medicine, and after seven weeks of evening walks his heart is better.
lessons.text:
Mahdi waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Hargeysa. Aabbaha Mahdi waa Jimcaale. Jimcaale wuxuu jiraa 60 sano. Wuxuu aad u jecel yahay bariis. Maalin kasta wuxuu cunaa bariis badan oo saliid badan leh. Jimcaale ma socdo. Maalinta oo dhan kursi ayuu ku fadhiyaa.

Maalin, Jimcaale wuxuu dareemay xanuun weyn. "Mahdi, wadnahayga ayaa xanuun leh," ayuu yidhi. Cabsi weyn ayaa Mahdi ku dhacday. Labadoodu waxay si degdeg ah u tageen isbitaalka.

Isbitaalka, dhakhtarka ayaa dhagaystay wadnaha Jimcaale. Muddo ayuu dhagaystay. Kadib wuxuu eegay culeyska Jimcaale.

"Culeyskaagu waa badan yahay," ayuu yidhi dhakhtarku. "Culeys badan iyo saliid badan dhib bay u yihiin wadnaha. Bariis yar cun. Galab kasta soco. Marka aad xanuun dareento, joogso oo naso. Sidoo kale daawadan qaado."

Mahdi wuxuu tagay dukaanka daawada. Daawadu way qaali ahayd. "Mahdi, daawadu aad bay u qaali tahay," ayuu yidhi Jimcaale.

"Aabbe, lacagtu muhiim ma aha," ayuu yidhi Mahdi. "Caafimaadkaaga ayaa muhiim ah." Mahdi wuu iibsaday daawadii qaaliga ahayd.

Galabtii dambe, Mahdi iyo aabbaha way wada socdeen. Jimcaale wuxuu socday muddo yar, kadib wuu joogsaday oo wuu nastay. Mar kale ayuu socday, mar kale ayuu joogsaday.

"Mahdi, ma socon karo," ayuu yidhi Jimcaale.

"Aabbe, naso," ayuu yidhi Mahdi. "Kadib waynu socon doonnaa."

Toddoba toddobaad ayay sidaas sameeyeen. Galab kasta way wada socdeen. Jimcaale bariis yar ayuu cunay. Mar kasta wuxuu socday wax ka badan, wuuna joogsaday wax ka yar.

Toddobada toddobaad kadib, Jimcaale mar kale ayuu isbitaalka tagay. Dhakhtarku mar kale ayuu dhagaystay wadnaha. "Wadnahaagu hadda waa fiican yahay," ayuu yidhi. "Culeyskaaguna wuu yaraaday. Haddii aad sidan sii wado, cimri dheer ayaad yeelan doontaa."

Jimcaale wuu qoslay. "Cimri dheer ayaan rabaa," ayuu yidhi. "Wiilkayga Mahdi ayaa i caawiyay."

Su'aalo:
Jimcaale muxuu jecel yahay?
Jimcaale wuxuu jecel yahay bariis.
Dhakhtarku muxuu dhagaystay?
Dhakhtarku wuxuu dhagaystay wadnaha Jimcaale.
Daawadu ma qaali ahayd?
Haa, daawadu way qaali ahayd.
Jimcaale muxuu sameeyay markuu muddo yar socday?
Markuu muddo yar socday, wuu joogsaday oo wuu nastay.
Toddoba toddobaad ma wada socdeen?
Haa, toddoba toddobaad ayay wada socdeen.

lessons.title: Habeenka qabowga
lessons.summary: On a very cold night in Ceerigaabo, Hinda's baby wakes up crying; she lights the lamp, finds him cold, takes him into her bed and lights charcoal, opens the door a little because charcoal in a closed room is dangerous, and they sleep until dawn.
lessons.text:
Hinda waa hooyo dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Ceerigaabo. Waxay leedahay cunug yar oo afar bilood jira. Ceerigaabo waa magaalo buuro ku dhow, habeenkiina aad bay u qabow tahay. Xilliga qabowga, dadku habeen kasta dab bay shidaan.

Habeen, qabowgu aad buu u badnaa. Hinda iyo cunuggeeda way seexdeen. Cunuggu wuxuu seexdaa sariir yar oo u dhow sariirta Hinda.

Habeenkii dhexdiisa, cunuggu qaylo ayuu bilaabay. Qayladiisu way weynayd. Hinda hurdada way ka kacday. Qolku wuu mugdi ahaa. Mugdiga dhexdiisa waxba lama arki karin. Hinda waxay shidday nalka. Kadib waxay eegtay cunugga.

Cunuggu wuu qabow ahaa. Gacantiisa yari way qabow ahayd. "Qabowga ayaa ku haya," ayay tidhi Hinda. Waxay cunugga ka qaadday sariirtiisa yar, waxayna dhigtay sariirteeda weyn. Waxay u xidhay dhar kale.

Kadib Hinda waxay shidday dhuxul. Dabka dhuxusha darteed, qolku wuu kululaaday. Laakiin Hinda waxay garatay wax hooyadeed mar u sheegtay: "Dhuxusha ha ku seexan qol xidhan. Waa halis." Sidaas darteed Hinda albaabka wax yar ayay ka furtay.

Cunuggu qaylada wuu joojiyay. Wuu seexday. Hurdo fiican ayuu seexday. Hinda sidoo kale way seexatay.

Kadib dhuxushii way dhammaatay, dabkiina wuu dhintay. Qolku mar kale wuu mugdi noqday. Hinda way kacday oo nalka ayay shidday. Cunugga ayay eegtay. Cunuggu wuu kululaa, hurdo fiicanna wuu ku jiray. Hinda mar kale way seexatay.

Aroortii iftiinka ayaa qolka soo galay. Cunuggu hurdada wuu ka kacay. Qaylo ma uusan samayn. Wuu qoslay.

Hinda way faraxsanayd. "Hurdo fiican ayaad seexatay," ayay tidhi. "Qabowgu wuu tagay." Aroortaas Hinda waxay u sheegtay hooyadeed sida habeenku ahaa.

Su'aalo:
Hinda meeshee bay ku nool tahay?
Hinda waxay ku nool tahay Ceerigaabo.
Habeenkii dhexdiisa maxaa dhacay?
Habeenkii dhexdiisa cunuggu qaylo ayuu bilaabay.
Hinda maxay shidday?
Hinda waxay shidday nalka iyo dhuxusha.
Hinda maxay albaabka u furtay?
Waayo dhuxushu waa halis marka qolku xidhan yahay.
Cunuggu aroortii ma qaylo sameeyay?
Maya, aroortii cunuggu qaylo ma uusan samayn. Wuu qoslay.

lessons.title: Lugta bidix
lessons.summary: Twelve-year-old Aweys in Garoowe plays football with his right foot; a boy hits his left leg from behind, a stone tears his clothes and the leg swells, his friend Nuuh brings ice, the doctor gives him a stick, and on the fifth day the doctor allows him to play again.
lessons.text:
Aweys waa wiil 12 sano jira oo ku nool Garoowe. Wuxuu aad u jecel yahay ciyaarta kubbadda cagta. Aweys cagaha labadooda ayuu ku ciyaaraa, laakiin had iyo jeer wuxuu wax ku dhuftaa lugtiisa midig. Lugtiisa bidix si fiican uma isticmaalo.

Galab, Aweys iyo saaxiibkiis Nuuh waxay ciyaarta ku jireen meel u dhow dugsiga. Wiil kale ayaa gadaal ka yimid. Wiilkii wuxuu ka dhuftay Aweys lugta bidix. Aweys wuu dhacay. Qaylo weyn ayuu sameeyay.

Markuu dhacay, dhagax ayaa dharkiisa jeexay. Lugtiisa bidix way bararday. Aweys ma istaagi karin.

Nuuh wuu soo orday. "Aweys, ha dhaqaaqin," ayuu yidhi. Nuuh wuxuu u orday dukaan u dhow. Baraf ayuu ka keenay. Barafka ayuu saaray lugta bidix. Barafku wuu qabow yahay, xanuunkiina wuu yaraaday.

Kadib Nuuh iyo Aweys waxay tageen gurigii Aweys. Hooyadiis waxay aragtay dharka jeexan iyo lugta bararday. "Aweys, maxaa dhacay?" ayay tidhi.

"Wiil ayaa gadaal iga soo dhuftay," ayuu yidhi Aweys.

Hooyadiis waxay la tagtay isbitaalka. Dhakhtarka ayaa eegay lugta bidix iyo lugta midig. "Lafta ma jabin," ayuu yidhi. "Laakiin lugtan culeys ha saarin. Ul ku soco. Maalin kasta baraf saar. Maalinta shanaad ii kaalay."

Maalin kasta, ilaa maalinta shanaad, Aweys wuxuu ku socday ul. Usha waxay ahayd tii ayeeyadiis. Maalin kasta hooyadiis baraf ayay lugta u saartay. Bararku wuu yaraaday.

Maalinta shanaad, Aweys iyo hooyadiis mar kale ayay tageen isbitaalka. Mar kale ayaa lugta la eegay. "Hadda way fiican tahay," ayuu yidhi. "Waan kuu oggolaaday inaad ciyaarto," ayuu yidhi dhakhtarku. "Laakiin cagaha si fiican u dhaq, kabo fiicanna xidho."

Aweys aad buu u faraxsanaa. Usha wuu dhigay. Cagaha ayuu dhaqay, kabo cusubna wuu xidhay. Hadda cagaha labaduba way fiican yihiin. Galabtaas wuxuu u orday meesha Nuuh joogay. Mar kale ayay ciyaareen.

Su'aalo:
Aweys had iyo jeer muxuu wax ku dhuftaa?
Aweys had iyo jeer wuxuu wax ku dhuftaa lugtiisa midig.
Wiilkii meeshee buu ka yimid?
Wiilkii gadaal ayuu ka yimid.
Nuuh muxuu keenay?
Nuuh wuxuu keenay baraf.
Aweys muxuu ku socday?
Aweys wuxuu ku socday ul.
Dhakhtarku ma u oggolaaday inuu ciyaaro?
Haa, maalinta shanaad ayuu dhakhtarku u oggolaaday inuu ciyaaro.

lessons.title: Riyaha iyo qorraxda
lessons.summary: In the hot season near Gaalkacyo, young Mowliid takes the goats to graze in the bush; his uncle Dhoorre warns him about the sun, the lions and the leopards, but Mowliid takes little water, grows hungry and dizzy, rests under a leafy tree and brings the goats home, where his uncle gives him fresh well water.
lessons.text:
Mowliid waa wiil 13 sano jira oo ku nool miyiga Gaalkacyo. Wuxuu la nool yahay adeerkiis Dhoorre. Qoyskoodu wuxuu leeyahay riyo badan.

Xagaaga, miyigu aad buu u kulul yahay. Qorraxdu way kulul tahay, dabayshuna way kulul tahay. Subax kasta Mowliid riyaha ayuu duurka la tagaa. Riyaha ayaa duurka ku daaqa.

Subax, Dhoorre wuxuu yidhi: "Mowliid, qorraxda xagaaga waa halis. Kulaylku wuu dili karaa qofka. Biyo badan qaado, madaxana dhar ku xidh. Sidoo kale duurka libaax iyo shabeel ayaa ku jira. Riyaha ha ka fogaan."

Mowliid wuu degdegay. Biyo yar ayuu qaatay, cunto ma uusan qaadan. Riyaha ayuu duurka u wareejiyay. Riyaha ayaa halkaas ku daaqay.

Kadib qorraxdu aad bay u kululaatay. Dabaysha kulul ayaa dhulka ka kacday. Mowliid biyaha yar wuu cabbay. Kadib gaajo ayaa ku dhacday. Madax xanuun ayaa ku dhacay.

Mowliid wuxuu arkay geed weyn oo caleemo badan leh. Hooska geedka ayuu hoos fadhiistay. Caleenta geedka ayaa qorraxda ka ilaalisay. Halkaas ayuu ku nastay.

Markaas Mowliid wuxuu maqlay cod weyn oo duurka ka yimid. "Ma libaax baa?" ayuu is weydiiyay. "Mise waa shabeel?" Cabsi ayaa ku dhacday. Riyaha ayuu isku keenay, guriga ayuu u celiyay.

Markuu gurigii yimid, Dhoorre wuxuu arkay wajiga Mowliid. "Gaajo iyo kulayl ayaa ku haya," ayuu yidhi. Wuxuu Mowliid siiyay biyo ceelka laga keenay. Biyaha ceelkaasi waa mac. "Biyahan mac ah cab," ayuu yidhi Dhoorre. Kadib wuxuu siiyay caano iyo cunto.

Mowliid wuu cabbay, wuuna cunay. Gaajadii way tagtay. "Adeer, berri biyo badan iyo cunto ayaan qaadan doonaa," ayuu yidhi. "Duurka xagaaga waa halis."

Su'aalo:
Mowliid riyaha meeshee buu la tagaa?
Mowliid riyaha wuxuu la tagaa duurka.
Dhoorre muxuu yidhi duurka ku saabsan?
Dhoorre wuxuu yidhi duurka libaax iyo shabeel ayaa ku jira.
Mowliid meeshee buu ku nastay?
Mowliid wuxuu ku nastay hooska geed caleemo badan leh.
Biyaha ceelku waa sidee?
Biyaha ceelku waa mac.

lessons.title: Timaha Sundus
lessons.summary: Sixteen-year-old Sundus in Jigjiga sees in the mirror that her hair is falling out and grows sad; her white-haired grandmother Lul tells her to eat well, sleep and keep her hair clean, mixes oil and water in her palm for her hair, and after a month the hair is strong again.
lessons.text:
Sundus waa gabadh 16 jir ah oo ku nool Jigjiga. Waxay leedahay timo dheer oo madow. Subax kasta muraayadda ayay is eegtaa. Kadib timaheeda ayay ku xidhaa qoorta gadaasheeda.

Bishan Sundus wax badan ayay akhrinaysaa. Habeenkii way akhridaa, cunto yarna way cuntaa.

Subax, Sundus waxay is eegtay muraayadda. Timo badan ayaa madaxeeda ka dhacay. Murugo ayaa ku dhacday. Ilmo ayaa wajigeeda ku soo daatay. Muraayadduna nadiif ma ahayn. Sundus way tirtirtay muraayadda, kadibna ilmaheeda ayay tirtirtay.

Ayeeyadeed Lul ayaa qolka soo gashay. Lul waa naag da' weyn. Timaheedu way cad yihiin. Caddaanka timaheedu waa calaamad cimri dheer. Lul waa naag aqoon badan.

"Sundus, maxaa kugu dhacay? Murugo ayaa kaa muuqata," ayay tidhi Lul.

"Ayeeyo, timahaygii way dhacayaan," ayay tidhi Sundus. Murugadeedu way weynayd.

"Ma cuntaa cunto fiican? Ma seexataa?" ayay weydiisay Lul.

"Maya. Habeenkii waan akhriyaa. Cunto yar ayaan cunaa," ayay tidhi Sundus.

"Timo fiican waxay u baahan yihiin cunto iyo hurdo, sidoo kale waa inay nadiif ahaadaan," ayay tidhi Lul. "Timahaaga nadiif ka dhig. Cunto fiican cun. Habeenkii seexo."

Kadib Lul waxay sacabkeeda ku qastay saliid iyo biyo. Kadib way qastay mar kale. Sacabkeeda ayay timaha Sundus ku marisay. Kadib gacanteeda ayay qoorta Sundus saartay. "Qoortaadu way adag tahay. Waxaad u baahan tahay inaad nasato," ayay tidhi.

Bil ayay Sundus sidaas samaysay. Habeen kasta way seexatay. Cunto fiican ayay cuntay. Timaheeda way nadiif ahaayeen. Toddobaad kasta Lul saliidda ayay sacabkeeda ku qastay oo timaha ayay u marisay.

Bishii kadib, Sundus muraayadda ayay is eegtay. Timaheedu xoog bay lahaayeen. Murugadii way tagtay. Sundus waxay eegtay caddaanka timaha ayeeyadeed oo way qososhay. "Ayeeyo, waxaad tahay naag wanaagsan," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Sundus subax kasta maxay eegtaa?
Sundus subax kasta waxay eegtaa muraayadda.
Sundus maxay murugo u qabtay?
Waayo timaheeda ayaa dhacayay.
Timaha Lul waa sidee?
Timaha Lul way cad yihiin.
Lul maxay sacabkeeda ku qastay?
Lul waxay sacabkeeda ku qastay saliid iyo biyo.

lessons.title: Macallinka iyo wadnaha
lessons.summary: In a school in Boosaaso the teacher Shariif teaches the class to count heartbeats at the neck; Bisharo, new from London, does not understand, so he repeats it and a classmate translates; they count to forty, and he ends with a proverb and a reminder to wash hands.
lessons.text:
Shariif waa macallin ka shaqeeya dugsi ku yaal Boosaaso. Macallinku wuxuu wax baraa carruur 11 jir ah. Maanta macallinku wuxuu ka hadlayaa jidhka iyo wadnaha.

Carruurta waxaa ku jirta gabadh cusub oo la yidhaahdo Bisharo. Bisharo waxay ka timid London. Soomaali way ku hadashaa, laakiin erayo badan ma garato.

"Wadne kasta wuu garaacaa," ayuu yidhi macallinku. "Maanta waxaynu baran doonnaa tirinta garaaca wadnaha. Gacanta qoorta saara. Ma dareentaan garaaca?"

Carruurtu gacanta qoorta ayay saareen. Bisharo macallinka ma kasin. Way fadhiday, wax ma samayn.

"Bisharo, ma fahantay?" ayuu weydiiyay macallinku.

"Maya, macallin. Ma kasin," ayay tidhi Bisharo.

Macallinku wuu celceliyay. Si degdeg ah uma hadlin. Mar kale ayuu celceliyay: "Gacanta qoorta saar. Garaaca wadnaha dareen." Sacdiya oo ah gabadh kale oo Ingiriisi taqaan ayaa u tarjuntay Bisharo. Kadib Bisharo way fahantay. Gacanta ayay qoorta saartay.

"Hadda aynu tirinno," ayuu yidhi macallinku. "Kow, laba, saddex..." Carruurtu way la tiriyeen: "Kow, laba, saddex, afar..." Tirintu waxay socotay muddo gaaban. Carruurta qaar waxay gaadheen afartan. Bisharo sidoo kale waxay gaadhay afartan.

"Afartan ayaan helay!" ayay tidhi Bisharo. Way faraxsanayd. Hadda tirinta way fahantay.

Dhammaadkii, macallinku wuxuu qoray maahmaah: "Aqoon la'aan waa iftiin la'aan." Wuxuu celceliyay maahmaahda, carruurtuna way la celceliyeen. Sacdiya waxay maahmaahda u tarjuntay Bisharo. Bisharo maahmaahda way fahantay.

Kadib macallinku wuxuu carruurta xasuusiyay: "Ka hor cuntada gacmaha dhaqa." Mar kale ayuu xasuusiyay: "Biyo badan cabba."

Bisharo way faraxsanayd. "Macallin, maanta wax badan ayaan bartay," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Shariif waa kuma?
Shariif waa macallin ka shaqeeya dugsi ku yaal Boosaaso.
Bisharo meeshee bay ka timid?
Bisharo waxay ka timid London.
Yaa u tarjumay Bisharo?
Sacdiya ayaa u tarjuntay Bisharo.
Bisharo afartan ma gaadhay?
Haa, Bisharo waxay gaadhay afartan.
Macallinku muxuu carruurta xasuusiyay?
Macallinku wuxuu carruurta xasuusiyay inay gacmaha dhaqaan.

lessons.title: Mootada Cabdiwali
lessons.summary: Cabdiwali in Kismaayo drives his motorcycle too fast; the police fine him and say he drives like a thief, he ties a sack of rice on with a weak rope that comes loose, he falls and the doctor treats his arm, and his father, who once rode a horse, keeps the key for a week.
lessons.text:
Cabdiwali waa nin dhallinyar ah oo ku nool Kismaayo. Wuxuu leeyahay mooto cusub. Maalin kasta mootada ayuu kaxeeyaa. Wuxuu jecel yahay inuu si degdeg ah u kaxeeyo.

Aabbaha Cabdiwali ayaa mar kasta u sheega: "Cabdiwali, si degdeg ah ha u kaxaynin. Mootadu waa halis."

Maalin, Cabdiwali mootada si degdeg ah ayuu u kaxeeyay. Booliska ayaa joojiyay. Askari ayaa u yimid. "Waxaad u kaxaynaysaa sida tuug ka cararaya booliska," ayuu yidhi askarigu. "Tuug ma tihid, laakiin sida tuug ayaad u kaxaynaysaa."

Askarigu ganaax ayuu saaray Cabdiwali. Ganaaxu wuxuu ahaa malaayiin shilin. "Malaayiin shilin!" ayuu yidhi Cabdiwali. Caro ayaa ku dhacday, laakiin ganaaxii wuu bixiyay. Shilinkii uu haystay oo dhan ayuu bixiyay.

Toddobaad kadib, Cabdiwali kiis bariis ah ayuu suuqa ka iibsaday. Kiiska wuxuu ku xidhay mootada gadaasheeda. Xarig jilicsan ayuu ku xidhay. Kadib mar kale si degdeg ah ayuu u kaxeeyay.

Waddada dhexdeeda xariggii wuu furmay. Kiiskii wuu dhacay. Cabdiwali gadaal ayuu eegay, mootadiina way dhacday. Cabdiwali dhulka ayuu ku dhacay. Gacantiisa midig dhiig ayaa ka yimid.

Dad ayaa u yimid oo isbitaalka ayay la tageen. Dhakhtarku wuxuu la tacaalay gacanta Cabdiwali. Si fiican ayuu ula tacaalay. "Lafta ma jabin," ayuu yidhi. "Laakiin muddo ha kaxaynin mootada."

Aabbaha ayaa isbitaalka yimid. "Cabdiwali, markii aan dhallinyarada ahaa, faras ayaan fuuli jiray," ayuu yidhi. "Faraskaygu wuxuu ahaa faras xoog badan, laakiin waan ilaalin jiray. Faras iyo mooto, labaduba waa halis marka qofku degdego."

Kadib aabbaha wuxuu qaatay furaha mootada. "Furaha toddobaad ayaan haysan doonaa," ayuu yidhi.

Toddobaad kadib aabbaha furaha wuu u celiyay. Hadda Cabdiwali mootada si degdeg ah uma kaxeeyo. Xarig cusub oo adagna wuu iibsaday.

Su'aalo:
Cabdiwali muxuu leeyahay?
Cabdiwali wuxuu leeyahay mooto cusub.
Askarigu muxuu yidhi?
Askarigu wuxuu yidhi: "Sida tuug ayaad u kaxaynaysaa."
Ganaaxu muxuu ahaa?
Ganaaxu wuxuu ahaa malaayiin shilin.
Maxaa furmay?
Xariggii ayaa furmay.
Aabbaha Cabdiwali muxuu fuuli jiray?
Aabbaha Cabdiwali wuxuu fuuli jiray faras.
Aabbaha muxuu qaatay?
Aabbaha wuxuu qaatay furaha mootada.

lessons.title: Xarunta caafimaadka ee Baydhabo
lessons.summary: Fartuun founded a small health centre in Baydhabo twenty years ago; in a year of plenty the town and Somalis around the world help her expand it to forty beds, she joins a health alliance to wipe out a disease, and she defends the children's health before the new democratic government.
lessons.text:
Fartuun waa dhakhtar ku nool Baydhabo. 20 sano ka hor ayay asaastay xarun caafimaad oo yar. Markii ay asaastay xarunta, mugga xaruntu wuxuu ahaa toban sariir oo kaliya. Bukaan badan ayaa yimaada, laakiin sariiraha way yaraayeen.

Sannad, roob badan ayaa da'ay. Barwaaqo ayaa magaalada iyo miyiga gashay. Xoolaha way wanaagsanaayeen, caano iyo cunto badanna way jireen. Dadka barwaaqadu gaadhay waxay Fartuun u keeneen lacag. "Xarunta ballaari," ayay yidhaahdeen.

Sidoo kale dad ku nool meelo kale oo adduunyada ah ayaa lacag soo diray. Soomaalida ku nool London iyo Minneapolis ayaa caawiyay. "Adduunyada oo dhan ayaa caawin karta," ayay tidhi Fartuun.

Fartuun xarunta way ballaarisay. Mugga xaruntu wuxuu noqday afartan sariir. Sidoo kale qol cusub oo carruurta u gaar ah ayay dhistay.

Caafimaadka magaalada hormar weyn ayaa ku yimid. Xaruntu sidoo kale way hormartay. Shaqaale cusub ayaa yimid.

Laakiin cudur ayaa carruurta ku dhacay. Fartuun waxay gashay isbahaysi caafimaad oo gobolka ah. Isbahaysigu wuxuu rabay inuu cudurka dabar gooyo. "Cudurkan waa in la dabar gooyaa," ayay tidhi Fartuun. Isbahaysigu wuxuu carruurta siiyay daawo. Laba sannadood kadib cudurku wuu yaraaday.

Sannadkaas dowlad cusub oo dimoqraadi ah ayaa timid. Dowladda dimoqraadiga ah waxay rabtay inay lacag yar siiso caafimaadka. Fartuun way diiday. Shir ayay tagtay oo waxay ka hadashay difaacida caafimaadka carruurta.

"Caafimaadka carruurta waan difaaci doonaa," ayay tidhi. "Aayaha dalka waa carruurta. Haddii carruurtu caafimaad qabto, aayaha dalku wuu wanaagsanaan doonaa." Dowladdu way aqbashay. Lacagtii lama yarayn.

Hadda Fartuun way ku faraxsan tahay xarunta ay asaastay. "Isbahaysigeenna ayaa cudurka dabar goynaya," ayay tidhi.

Su'aalo:
Fartuun maxay asaastay?
Fartuun waxay asaastay xarun caafimaad.
Mugga xaruntu muxuu noqday?
Mugga xaruntu wuxuu noqday afartan sariir.
Isbahaysigu muxuu rabay?
Isbahaysigu wuxuu rabay inuu cudurka dabar gooyo.
Fartuun maxay ka hadashay shirka?
Fartuun waxay ka hadashay difaacida caafimaadka carruurta.
Fartuun maxay tidhi aayaha dalka ku saabsan?
Fartuun waxay tidhi: "Aayaha dalka waa carruurta."

lessons.title: Fiidka Oslo
lessons.summary: Old Saabir in Oslo walks to the mosque every evening because his doctor told him to; one evening a cold rain falls and he takes refuge in a church, where Ingrid gives him tea, and the two talk about prayer, paradise and respect.
lessons.text:
Saabir waa nin da' weyn oo ku nool Oslo. Dhakhtar ayaa u sheegay: "Fiid kasta soco." Sidaas darteed fiid kasta Saabir wuxuu u socdaa masjidka. Masjidka ayuu ku tukadaa, kadibna guriga ayuu ku noqdaa.

Fiidkii, Saabir cirka ayuu eegaa. Xiddigo badan ayuu arkaa. Dayaxa ayuu arkaa. "Xiddigaha iyo dayaxa Oslo waa sida kuwa Soomaaliya," ayuu is yidhaahdaa.

Fiid, Saabir masjidka ayuu tagay oo wuu tukaday. Markuu masjidka ka baxay, cirka xiddig iyo dayax midna kuma jirin. Roob qabow ayaa da'ay. Dabayl iyo baraf ayaa la socday.

Waddada dhexdeeda waxaa ku taal kaniisad weyn. Albaabka kaniisadda wuu furnaa. Qabow ayaa Saabir ku dhacay. Kaniisadda ayuu magan ka galay.

Gudaha kaniisadda naag ayaa joogtay. Magaceedu waa Ingrid. "Soo gal," ayay tidhi. "Halkan magan ayaad ka heli kartaa." Waxay siisay koob caano kulul ah.

"Mahadsanid," ayuu yidhi Saabir. "Fiid kasta masjidka ayaan u tagaa oo waan tukadaa. Waxaa la ii sheegay inaan socdo."

"Anigu sidoo kale halkan ayaan ku tukadaa," ayay tidhi Ingrid. "Kaniisaddani waa meesha aan ku tukado."

Way wada hadleen. Saabir wuxuu yidhi: "Waxaan rajaynayaa inaan galo jannada." Ingrid way dhagaysatay. "Anigu sidoo kale jannada ayaan rajaynayaa," ayay tidhi.

"Innaga diin kala duwan ayaynu leenahay," ayuu yidhi Saabir, "laakiin innaga waxaynu nahay dad. Waan ixtiraamaa diintaada."

"Anigu sidoo kale waan ixtiraamaa diintaada," ayay tidhi Ingrid. "Ixtiraamku waa muhiim."

Roobkii wuu joogsaday. Saabir wuu kacay. Albaabka ayuu ka baxay. Cirka xiddigo ayaa mar kale ka muuqday, dayaxuna wuu soo baxay. Saabir guriga ayuu ku socday. Fiidkaas wuu faraxsanaa.

Su'aalo:
Fiid kasta Saabir meeshee buu u socdaa?
Fiid kasta Saabir wuxuu u socdaa masjidka.
Maxaa da'ay fiidkaas?
Fiidkaas roob qabow ayaa da'ay.
Saabir meeshee buu magan ka galay?
Saabir wuxuu magan ka galay kaniisadda.
Ingrid maxay rajaynaysaa?
Ingrid waxay rajaynaysaa jannada.
Saabir muxuu ixtiraamaa?
Saabir wuxuu ixtiraamaa diinta Ingrid.

lessons.title: Qadada Qamar
lessons.summary: Qamar, a nurse in Minneapolis, is so busy that she never eats lunch; her daughter Nawaal says it is not right, they talk about what a good lunch is like, Qamar stores fruit and chicken in the fridge at work, and she learns that a busy person also has to eat to live well.
lessons.text:
Qamar waa kalkaaliso ka shaqeysa isbitaal ku yaal Minneapolis. Qamar aad bay u mashquul tahay. Subax kasta goor hore ayay shaqada tagtaa. Maalinta oo dhan bukaanka ayay caawisaa.

Qamar qado ma cunto. "Waan mashquul ahay. Qado waqti uma haysto," ayay tidhaahdaa.

Fiid, gabadheeda Nawaal ayaa weydiisay: "Hooyo, maanta qado ma cuntay?"

"Maya. Waan mashquul ahaa," ayay tidhi Qamar.

"Hooyo, saas ma aha," ayay tidhi Nawaal. "Bukaanka waad u sheegtaa inay cunaan. Adiguna waa inaad cuntaa. Haddii aad qado cunto, si fiican ayaad u shaqayn kartaa."

Qamar way qososhay. "Saas waa run," ayay tidhi. "Laakiin waxaan u baahanahay qado fudud."

Nawaal iyo hooyadeed waxay ka wada hadleen sifooyinka qado wanaagsan. "Sifada kowaad: waa inay fudud tahay," ayay tidhi Nawaal. "Sifada labaad: waa inay caafimaad leedahay. Sifada saddexaad: waa inay jidhka xoog siisaa."

"Miro ayaan cuni karaa," ayay tidhi Qamar. "Miro way fudud yihiin, caafimaadna way leeyihiin."

Habeenkaas Nawaal iyo Qamar waxay diyaariyeen qado. Waxay sameeyeen bariis iyo baal digaag. Miro badan ayay iibsadeen.

Subaxii dambe, Qamar waxay qadada la tagtay shaqada. Waxay ku kaydisay meel qabow oo isbitaalka ku taal. Miraha sidoo kale way kaydisay.

Maalintii dhexdeeda, Qamar way mashquul ahayd. Laakiin erayadii Nawaal ayay maskaxda ku haysay. Way joogsatay oo qadadii ayay cuntay: bariis iyo baal digaag. Kadib miro ayay cuntay.

Galabtii Qamar xoog bay lahayd. Si fiican ayay u shaqaysay.

Fiidkii, Qamar waxay tidhi: "Nawaal, run baad sheegtay. Qofka mashquulka ahi sidoo kale waa inuu cunaa. Haddii aad rabto inaad si fiican u noolaan karto, waa inaad cuntaa."

Hadda maalin kasta Qamar qado ayay kaydisaa, wayna cuntaa. "Waxaan rabaa inaan cimri dheer oo caafimaad leh noolaan karo," ayay tidhaahdaa.

Su'aalo:
Qamar maxay qado u cuni jirin?
Waayo Qamar aad bay u mashquul ahayd.
Nawaal maxay tidhi?
Nawaal waxay tidhi: "Hooyo, saas ma aha."
Qamar maxay ku kaydisay meesha qabow?
Qamar waxay ku kaydisay qadada iyo miraha.
Qadadu maxay ahayd?
Qadadu waxay ahayd bariis iyo baal digaag.
